title: Tracing the Roots: A Multi-Agent Framework for Uncovering Data Lineage in Post-Training LLMs
authors_zh: Yu Li、Xiaoran Shang、Qizhi Pei、Yun Zhu、Xin Gao、Honglin Lin、Zhanping Zhong、Zhuoshi Pan、Zheng Liu、Xiaoyang Wang、Conghui He、Dahua Lin、Feng Zhao、Lijun Wu
paper_type_zh: 数据谱系审计与构造方法论文
best_for_zh: 关注后训练数据来源、混合去重、污染传播、根源采样与发布可审计性的研究者
one_line: Reconstructs a 430-node, 971-edge post-training dataset lineage graph and uses 31 upstream QA sources plus exact/MinHash deduplication to report a 570K diversity-oriented corpus that is not included in the verified release.
重建含 430 个节点、971 条边的后训练数据集谱系图，并从 31 个上游问答源经精确匹配与 MinHash 去重报告 57 万条多样性导向语料；经核验的官方发布并不包含该语料。
why: For the construction/open-release track, it turns upstream ancestry into a selection and audit layer, while showing why dataset-level edges, record-level provenance, benchmark overlap, and release licensing must be checked separately.
inclusion_reason: Makes dataset ancestry an explicit construction and audit object, then demonstrates how graph topology can guide root-source sampling, redundancy checks, and contamination tracing for post-training data.

title: Problem
问题
html:
The official source is the ACL 2026 long-paper record (July 2026, pages 9606-9625), cross-checked against arXiv v1, the accepted PDF, and the author repository. The paper addresses a specific blind spot in post-training data construction: datasets are repeatedly copied, filtered, distilled, reformulated, or merged, but their ancestry is scattered across dataset cards, papers, repositories, and blogs. A pairwise content scan may find duplicate rows, yet it does not by itself explain which upstream source introduced an overlap or how it propagated through later mixtures.

This belongs in data_construction_open_release_recipes because it treats provenance as an operational input to source selection, deduplication, and contamination auditing. Its boundary is dataset-to-dataset lineage inferred from public documentation; it is not record-level training-data attribution and cannot recover a source that creators omit or conceal.

Two data objects must remain separate. The first is a directed graph in which a dataset node is connected to an upstream source by an edge carrying a derivation relation, confidence, and textual evidence. The second is a reported instruction corpus: 31 selected upstream leaf datasets are normalized to Alpaca-style instruction/input/output records and deduplicated from about 8.7M rows to 570K instructions. The official repository releases graph and dataset-metadata JSONL files, but the inspected revision does not release the 570K corpus or per-row paths back through the graph. That release gap is part of the Card's inclusion boundary, not a detail to infer from the diversity results. (Paper Sections 3-5; Appendix A and E; official repository at revision 681db3ab13eaa4391025d6c4b86ed5b58b73988e.)

官方来源为 ACL 2026 长文记录（2026 年 7 月，第 9606-9625 页），并与 arXiv v1、正式 PDF 和作者仓库交叉核验。论文针对后训练数据构造中的一个具体盲区：数据集会被反复复制、筛选、蒸馏、改写或合并，但其祖先关系散落在数据卡、论文、仓库和博客中。逐条内容扫描或许能发现重复记录，却不能单独说明重叠由哪个上游源引入，又如何沿后续混合传播。

该工作归入 data_construction_open_release_recipes，因为它把 provenance 作为源选择、去重和污染审计的操作性输入。其边界是从公开文档推断数据集到数据集的谱系，而不是记录级训练数据归因；若创建者遗漏或刻意隐瞒来源，系统无法恢复该依赖。

必须区分两个数据对象。其一是有向图：数据集节点通过上游边相连，每条边带有派生关系、置信度和文本证据。其二是论文报告的指令语料：从 31 个上游叶节点数据集取得记录，归一化为 Alpaca 风格的 instruction/input/output，再由约 870 万条去重到 57 万条。官方仓库公开了图与数据集元数据 JSONL，但核验到的版本没有公开这 57 万条语料，也没有保留每条记录穿过谱系图的完整路径。这个发布缺口属于本卡片的收录边界，不能由多样性结果反推其已发布。（论文第 3-5 节、附录 A 与 E；官方仓库版本 681db3ab13eaa4391025d6c4b86ed5b58b73988e。）

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The contribution is a documentation-grounded, multi-agent pipeline that converts dispersed provenance statements into a recursive dataset lineage graph and then uses graph topology to choose less-derived source data.

For each candidate, a sourcing agent locates evidence, extracting agents summarize Hugging Face READMEs, web pages, and papers, tracing agents identify actual construction sources, and an aggregation agent merges duplicate claims and resolves aliases to canonical Hugging Face IDs. The edge relation is one of Semantic Evolution, CoT Distillation, Synthetic Generation, Structured Fusion, or Direct Inclusion/Subset. DFS expands newly discovered sources until the pipeline finds no ancestor or reaches the pre-2020 cutoff. Starting from 83 selected seeds, this process yields the reported 430-node, 971-edge graph. Leaf nodes with downstream reuse are then ranked by out-degree; 31 QA-oriented sources survive domain/format filtering and supply the diversity-oriented corpus.

The feedback contract is mixed rather than a correctness reward. Hugging Face availability, canonical-ID resolution, release-time consistency, agent confidence, supporting text, and low-confidence expert review decide whether a dataset-level edge is retained. Exact triplet matching measures source intersection; exact instruction/input matching checks five benchmarks; exact-Q and MinHash remove corpus duplicates. These checks can observe documented ancestry and literal overlap, but not concealed sources, paraphrased contamination, or whether an instruction has a correct and useful answer.

Relative to cataloguing provenance fields for isolated releases or scanning samples pairwise, the paper's direction signal is the use of graph ancestry as a reusable construction and audit layer. The closest conceptual comparison in this atlas is bridging-provenance-gap-2025, which audits source and rights metadata across releases; this paper instead infers directed derivation paths and applies them to source selection. Neither provides verified per-record ancestry for the resulting training rows.

本文的贡献是一条以文档证据为基础的多智能体流程：把分散的来源陈述转换为递归的数据集谱系图，再用图拓扑选择派生程度较低的数据源。

对每个候选数据集，sourcing agent 定位证据，extracting agents 汇总 Hugging Face README、网页和论文，tracing agents 识别真正用于构造的来源，aggregation agent 合并重复声明并把别名解析为规范的 Hugging Face ID。边关系限定为 Semantic Evolution、CoT Distillation、Synthetic Generation、Structured Fusion 或 Direct Inclusion/Subset。DFS 持续扩展新发现的来源，直到找不到祖先或触及 2020 年前的截止条件。从 83 个选定种子出发，论文报告得到 430 个节点、971 条边的图；随后按出度排序具有下游复用的叶节点，经领域与格式筛选留下 31 个问答源，供多样性导向语料使用。

这里的反馈契约是混合式审计，而非答案正确性奖励。Hugging Face 可用性、规范 ID 解析、发布时间一致性、智能体置信度、支持文本和低置信案例的专家复核共同决定是否保留数据集级边；完整三元组精确匹配用于测量源交集，instruction/input 精确匹配用于检查五个基准，exact-Q 与 MinHash 用于语料去重。这些检查能观察已公开的祖先关系和字面重叠，却看不到隐瞒的来源、释义式污染，也不能判断一条指令的答案是否正确且有训练价值。

相较于只为单个发布物登记来源字段，或逐对扫描样本，本文的方向信号在于把图上的祖先关系变成可复用的构造与审计层。Atlas 中最接近的概念对照是 bridging-provenance-gap-2025：后者跨发布物审计来源与权利元数据，本文则推断有向派生路径并将其用于源选择。两者都没有为最终训练记录提供经核验的逐条祖先关系。

title: Method
方法
html:
The paper-time pipeline can be reconstructed at the module level as follows.

  1. Seed and validate. Rank textual Hugging Face post-training datasets using downloads, community engagement, and reported downstream performance; choose 83 seeds across General, Math, Code, and Science. Deduplicate the pending queue, verify each candidate through the Hugging Face API, and set its effective date to the earlier of the Hugging Face timestamp and associated-paper date. Candidates before the modern post-2020 scope terminate recursion.
  2. Retrieve and clean evidence. A GPT-5.1 sourcing agent finds repositories, blogs, and papers from the dataset README. Gemini-2.5-Flash extracting agents fetch web content and arXiv material and remove metadata headers, code blocks, HTML, and irrelevant paper sections before building a shared evidence context.
  3. Extract source claims. Parallel GPT-5.1 tracing agents distinguish construction sources from evaluation benchmarks, baselines, and incidental citations. Each candidate edge is serialized as source, one of five relation types, confidence, and evidence.
  4. Aggregate, resolve, and expand. A Gemini-2.5-Pro aggregation agent deduplicates claims and uses online retrieval plus API checks to resolve aliases to org/name IDs. Temporal validation rejects a source newer than its target; unsupported low-confidence edges are pruned and other low-confidence cases are described as sent to experts. Accepted sources return to the queue, and DFS continues until no ancestor is found or the date cutoff applies.
  5. Audit literal overlap. Exact (instruction, input, output) hashes quantify intersections between source paths. Exact (instruction, input) matches measure leakage from Omni-MATH, TheoremQA, LiveCodeBench, TruthfulQA, and SciBench into downstream training datasets.
  6. Construct the diversity pool. From 212 unique leaves, rank by out-degree, remove leaves with no downstream use, exclude niche and non-QA sources, and keep 31 datasets. Normalize about 8.7M rows to Alpaca format, remove non-English and length-outlier records, perform exact-Q deduplication, then MinHash with 128 permutations, threshold 0.7, and 8-grams to report 570K instructions.
  7. Evaluate, not train. Embed instructions with Qwen3-Embedding-8B at dimension 4096 and compare Vendi Score and Centroid Distance with eight public baselines. The paper does not report SFT or other downstream training with the 570K corpus.

Reproduction requires a paper-time code revision, model endpoints, prompts, API responses, confidence and expert-routing thresholds, agent budgets, random seeds, the 83-seed manifest, all 430 nodes and 971 accepted edges, the 31-source row manifest, deduplication logs, and licenses. The current repository does not pin that complete run: its CLI defaults to gpt-5.4, while Appendix A assigns GPT-5.1, Gemini-2.5-Flash, and Gemini-2.5-Pro by agent role.

论文时点的流程可在模块层面重建如下。

  1. 种子选择与验证。 依据下载量、社区参与度和报告的下游模型表现，对 Hugging Face 文本后训练数据集排序，从 General、Math、Code、Science 四域选出 83 个种子。待处理队列先去重，再通过 Hugging Face API 验证候选；有效日期取 Hugging Face 时间戳与关联论文日期中较早者。超出 2020 年后现代 LLM 范围的候选会终止递归。
  2. 检索并清洗证据。 GPT-5.1 sourcing agent 从数据集 README 定位仓库、博客和论文；Gemini-2.5-Flash extracting agents 获取网页与 arXiv 材料，删除元数据头、代码块、HTML 和论文无关段落，再组成共享证据上下文。
  3. 抽取来源声明。 并行 GPT-5.1 tracing agents 区分真正的构造来源与评测基准、baseline、偶然引用；每条候选边被序列化为来源、五类关系之一、置信度和证据。
  4. 聚合、消歧与递归扩展。 Gemini-2.5-Pro aggregation agent 合并重复声明，并借助在线检索与 API 检查把别名解析为 org/name ID。时间验证拒绝晚于目标数据集的来源；缺乏支持的低置信边被剪除，其他低置信案例按论文描述交给专家。接受的来源重新进入队列，DFS 持续到找不到祖先或触及日期截止条件。
  5. 审计字面重叠。 对完整 (instruction, input, output) 三元组计算精确哈希，以量化源路径间交集；对 (instruction, input) 做精确匹配，以测量 Omni-MATH、TheoremQA、LiveCodeBench、TruthfulQA 和 SciBench 向下游训练集的泄漏。
  6. 构造多样性语料池。 从 212 个唯一叶节点按出度排序，去除没有下游使用的节点，排除小众领域和非问答源，保留 31 个数据集。把约 870 万条记录统一为 Alpaca 格式，过滤非英文与长度异常记录，先 exact-Q 去重，再采用 128 个哈希排列、阈值 0.7、8-gram 的 MinHash，最终报告 57 万条指令。
  7. 只评测，不训练。 使用 Qwen3-Embedding-8B、4096 维表示指令，并用 Vendi Score 与 Centroid Distance 同八个公开 baseline 比较。论文没有报告用这 57 万条语料进行 SFT 或其他下游训练。

复现需要固定论文时点代码、模型端点、prompt、API 响应、置信度与专家分流阈值、智能体预算、随机种子、83 个种子清单、430 个节点与 971 条接受边、31 源记录清单、去重日志和许可。当前仓库没有固定这套完整运行：其 CLI 默认模型已是 gpt-5.4，而附录 A 按角色使用 GPT-5.1、Gemini-2.5-Flash 和 Gemini-2.5-Pro。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The paper supplies evidence at three levels, which should not be collapsed into a single quality claim.

Graph-scale and topology evidence. Starting from 83 seeds, the authors report 430 distinct datasets and 971 inheritance edges. Table 1 gives average depth 1.05 for General versus 2.92 for Math, with 285 General, 99 Math, 98 Code, and 44 Science nodes; because datasets can span domains, these domain counts are not a partition of 430. These results support the descriptive claim that the observed General subgraph is broad and shallow while the Math subgraph is more recursively reused. They do not measure edge precision or recall against an independent gold graph.

Literal-overlap and contamination evidence. Section 4.2 reports that 17 of the 83 examined datasets have redundancy above 1% under exact (instruction, input, output) matching. Table 3's largest case is open-instruct-v1 at 46.48%; Fast-Math-R1-SFT is 5.30%. For benchmark overlap, exact (instruction, input) matching finds contamination across five benchmarks and 19 datasets. Appendix Table 10 reports, for example, Omni-MATH matches in DeepScaleR-Preview-Dataset at 79.48% (3502/4406), Big-Math-RL-Verified at 57.97% (2554/4406), and the downstream Caco-1.3M at 37.95% (1672/4406). These are direct exact-match findings under the authors' snapshots; they are lower bounds for transformed overlap and do not show that every matching row affected a model score.

Construction and diversity evidence. Appendix E reports that 212 unique leaves are reduced to 31 sources, about 8.7M normalized rows, and then 570K instructions after filtering and two-stage deduplication. Table 4 compares the resulting instructions with eight datasets using Qwen3-Embedding-8B representations: the authors report Vendi Score 452.44 and Centroid Distance 0.6385, the largest values in that table. This supports greater embedding dispersion under those metrics and baselines. It is not evidence that answers are correct, licenses are compatible, the corpus improves SFT, or the graph edges are accurate; no downstream model-training experiment is reported.

The official release only partially supports reproduction. At inspected commit 681db3ab13eaa4391025d6c4b86ed5b58b73988e, checked-in text-only outputs contain 443 dataset-metadata JSONL rows and 1092 graph-edge JSONL rows, while multimodal outputs contain 1161 and 2306 rows respectively. Those living-repository counts differ from the paper's 430/971 snapshot, and no 570K corpus is present. This is artifact-version evidence, not a correction to the paper's reported experiment.

论文提供了三个层次的证据，不能把它们合并成单一的“数据质量”结论。

图规模与拓扑证据。 从 83 个种子出发，作者报告 430 个不同数据集和 971 条继承边。表 1 给出 General 平均深度 1.05、Math 平均深度 2.92，并列出 285 个 General、99 个 Math、98 个 Code、44 个 Science 节点；由于一个数据集可跨领域，这些领域计数不是对 430 的互斥划分。这些结果支持“观察到的 General 子图宽而浅、Math 子图递归复用更深”的描述，但没有用独立 gold graph 测量边的 precision 或 recall。

字面重叠与污染证据。 第 4.2 节报告，在完整 (instruction, input, output) 精确匹配下，83 个被检查数据集中有 17 个的冗余率超过 1%。表 3 最大案例为 open-instruct-v1 的 46.48%，Fast-Math-R1-SFT 为 5.30%。基准重叠方面，对 (instruction, input) 的精确匹配在五个基准和 19 个数据集中发现污染。附录表 10 例如报告：DeepScaleR-Preview-Dataset 与 Omni-MATH 匹配 79.48%（3502/4406），Big-Math-RL-Verified 为 57.97%（2554/4406），下游 Caco-1.3M 为 37.95%（1672/4406）。这些是在作者快照与精确匹配条件下的直接发现，是变形重叠的下界，也不能证明每条匹配记录都影响了模型分数。

构造与多样性证据。 附录 E 报告从 212 个唯一叶节点筛到 31 个来源，将约 870 万条归一化记录经筛选和两阶段去重得到 57 万条指令。表 4 使用 Qwen3-Embedding-8B 表示，同八个数据集比较；作者报告 Vendi Score 452.44、Centroid Distance 0.6385，均为表中最高。这支持在给定表示、指标和 baseline 下具有更大的 embedding dispersion，却不是答案正确、许可兼容、SFT 有增益或图边准确的证据；论文没有报告下游模型训练实验。

官方发布只部分支持复现。在核验的提交 681db3ab13eaa4391025d6c4b86ed5b58b73988e 中，text-only 输出含 443 行数据集元数据 JSONL 和 1092 行图边 JSONL，multimodal 输出分别含 1161 行和 2306 行。这些活仓库计数不同于论文的 430/971 快照，且仓库中没有 57 万条语料。它们是 artifact 版本证据，不用于改写论文当时报告的实验。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The prior-work baseline is fragmented provenance documentation, audits of individual datasets or source rights, sample-level overlap scans, and instance-attribution methods. These approaches can describe one release or detect local similarity, but they do not directly model the evolutionary dependencies among many post-training datasets.

The concrete change is the unit of analysis and how it enters construction. The paper represents public source claims as a directed dataset graph with typed, evidence-bearing edges; recursively expands that graph with role-specialized agents; and then treats leaf status and downstream out-degree as source-selection signals. It also uses paths to identify where exact benchmark matches may have propagated, instead of reporting only a target dataset's aggregate overlap.

The new reasoning-data object is therefore not merely another instruction mixture. It is a dataset-level lineage record that can drive a review queue, source-mix exclusion, targeted content checks, and provenance-based sampling. This matters for the construction/open-release track because it makes ancestry a first-class decision variable before records are merged.

Several components are established rather than novel: web and paper retrieval, LLM extraction, DFS, exact hashing, MinHash, embeddings, Vendi Score, and Centroid Distance. The 570K corpus is primarily an engineering composition of 31 upstream datasets, not a newly verified answer-generation process. The paper also does not establish per-record lineage or a new correctness verifier.

Before reuse, inspect whether edge relations are explicit or inferred, how low-confidence cases were adjudicated, whether the graph and 31-source manifest match a stable paper-time release, how licenses propagate, and whether literal-match findings survive semantic-overlap checks. Those checks determine whether the graph is an audit instrument or only a useful hypothesis generator.

既有工作的基线包括分散的来源文档、针对单个数据集或源权利的审计、样本级重叠扫描和实例归因方法。这些方法能描述一个发布物或发现局部相似，却不直接建模大量后训练数据集之间的演化依赖。

本文的具体变化在于分析单位及其进入构造流程的方式：把公开来源声明表示为带类型和证据的有向数据集图，用按角色分工的智能体递归扩展该图，再把叶节点身份与下游出度作为源选择信号；同时沿路径定位基准精确匹配可能从何处传播，而不只报告目标数据集的聚合重叠率。

因此，新的 reasoning-data object 不只是另一份指令混合，而是可驱动复核队列、源混合排除、定向内容检查和 provenance-based sampling 的数据集级谱系记录。对构造与开放发布类别而言，其意义是让祖先关系在记录合并前成为一等决策变量。

多个组件沿用既有方法而非新发明，包括网页与论文检索、LLM 抽取、DFS、精确哈希、MinHash、embedding、Vendi Score 和 Centroid Distance。57 万条语料主要是 31 个上游数据集的工程整合，不是新的答案验证生成流程；论文也没有建立记录级谱系或新的正确性 verifier。

复用前应检查：边关系是明确声明还是模型推断，低置信案例如何裁决，图与 31 源清单能否对应到稳定的论文时点发布，许可如何沿谱系传播，以及字面匹配结论能否经受语义重叠检查。这些核验决定该图能否作为审计工具，还是只能作为有价值的假设生成器。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The authors state two primary limitations: LLM extraction can hallucinate and therefore needs human verification for low-confidence cases, and the graph is bounded by documentary transparency, so omitted or concealed sources cannot be recovered. The public materials leave several additional reuse risks.

Graph and feedback limits. There is no independently labeled edge set, precision/recall result, confidence calibration, expert-routing threshold, reviewer count, adjudication rule, or agreement statistic. Appendix A.3 says vague descriptions can be interpreted contextually or assigned the default Direct Inclusion/Subset relation. A false-positive edge can create a spurious contamination path; a false-negative edge can make a derived dataset appear to be a leaf. These are curator inferences from the feedback contract, not author-reported error rates.

Record and release limits. Dataset-level edges do not preserve the origin of each normalized instruction. The reported 570K corpus, per-row source IDs, transformation logs, accepted/rejected manifests, split, checksums, and corpus license were not found in the repository. The repository itself has no LICENSE file, tag, or release. Consequently, the code recipe can be inspected, but direct training reuse of the reported corpus is blocked pending an immutable artifact and rights review.

Audit limits. Exact triplet and exact question matching have high interpretability but miss paraphrases, translations, reordered fields, synthetic rewrites, and answer-only contamination. MinHash reduces near-duplicate instructions under one configuration but does not prove benchmark decontamination. Conversely, a documented ancestor does not prove that a particular benchmark row survived every downstream transformation.

Evaluation limits. Vendi Score and Centroid Distance depend on Qwen3-Embedding-8B and capture dispersion rather than correctness, difficulty, safety, or training utility. The comparison does not isolate source selection from normalization and deduplication, and no SFT experiment tests whether the 570K corpus improves a model. Benchmark performance therefore cannot be used here as proof of data quality; none is reported for the constructed corpus.

Version limits. The inspected repository postdates the paper experiment and defaults to gpt-5.4, whereas Appendix A uses GPT-5.1, Gemini-2.5-Flash, and Gemini-2.5-Pro by role. Its checked-in JSONL row counts also differ from 430/971. Without a tagged paper snapshot, API/model behavior, prompts, web evidence, and graph outputs can drift.

作者明确提出两项主要局限：LLM 抽取会产生幻觉，因此低置信案例需要人工核验；谱系图受公开文档透明度限制，遗漏或隐瞒的来源无法恢复。公开材料还留下以下复用风险。

图与反馈限制。 论文没有独立标注的边集合、precision/recall、置信度校准、专家分流阈值、复核者数量、裁决规则或一致性统计。附录 A.3 说明，模糊描述可以根据上下文推断，也可能默认标为 Direct Inclusion/Subset。假阳性边会制造虚假的污染路径，假阴性边会使派生数据集看似叶节点；这些是根据反馈契约作出的 curator inference，不是作者报告的错误率。

记录与发布限制。 数据集级边不保留每条归一化指令的来源。仓库中没有找到论文报告的 57 万条语料、逐条源 ID、转换日志、接受/拒绝清单、split、checksum 或语料许可；仓库本身也没有 LICENSE、tag 或 release。因此代码 recipe 可供检查，但在获得不可变 artifact 并完成权利审查前，不能把所述语料视为可直接训练复用的发布物。

审计限制。 完整三元组和问题精确匹配易解释，却会漏掉释义、翻译、字段重排、合成改写和仅答案污染。MinHash 在一个固定配置下减少近重复指令，但不等于完成基准去污染。反过来，存在文档化祖先也不能证明某条基准记录穿过所有下游转换后仍被保留。

评测限制。 Vendi Score 与 Centroid Distance 依赖 Qwen3-Embedding-8B，测量的是分散程度，不是正确性、难度、安全性或训练效用。比较没有隔离源选择、格式归一化与去重的作用，也没有通过 SFT 验证 57 万条语料是否提升模型。因此不能把 benchmark performance 当作数据质量证明；论文事实上没有报告该构造语料的模型成绩。

版本限制。 核验的仓库版本晚于论文实验，默认模型已是 gpt-5.4，而附录 A 按角色使用 GPT-5.1、Gemini-2.5-Flash 与 Gemini-2.5-Pro；仓库内 JSONL 行数也不同于 430/971。没有带标签的论文快照时，API/模型行为、prompt、网页证据和图输出都会漂移。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For the assigned data_construction_open_release_recipes track, the strongest use is as a provenance-first design and audit pattern, not as a ready-to-train dataset release.

Construction planning. Before mixing two datasets, trace their upstream families and avoid selecting a source together with a derivative or superset. Use the graph to identify high-reuse ancestors, then run content checks only on the implicated paths. This can reduce the search space, but it does not replace record-level deduplication.

Contamination and rights audit. If a benchmark or restrictive source appears upstream, enumerate all reachable descendants and prioritize them for exact, near-duplicate, and semantic checks. Carry license and source-document evidence along edges as audit metadata. The paper demonstrates path tracing; adding rights propagation would be a downstream extension, not a reported feature.

Reproducible release design. A stronger implementation should publish a versioned edge ledger with evidence snapshots, reviewer decisions, confidence calibration, graph checksums, and accepted/rejected edges. Any constructed row should retain source dataset and record IDs, transformations, deduplication outcomes, and split assignment. This turns a graph-level hypothesis into a record-level release ledger.

Controlled experiments. Compare random source sampling, downstream-mixture sampling, and leaf-guided sampling at fixed unique-instruction count, verifier, optimizer, and compute. Evaluate answer correctness and downstream training alongside diversity metrics. Such an experiment would test the paper's construction hypothesis rather than assuming larger embedding dispersion means better training data.

Reuse class: the code and released JSONL graph outputs are suitable as a reading, audit, and reconstruction starting point after pinning commit 681db3ab13eaa4391025d6c4b86ed5b58b73988e. The reported 570K corpus is blocked for training reuse because no immutable corpus, license, split, checksums, or record-level lineage was verified. The project should not be treated as an evaluation benchmark with a fixed hidden test.

对指定的 data_construction_open_release_recipes 类别而言，本文最强的用途是 provenance-first 的设计与审计范式，而不是可直接训练的数据集发布。

构造规划。 混合两个数据集前先追踪其上游家族，避免同时选择某个来源及其派生物或超集。可以用图识别高复用祖先，再只对相关路径执行内容检查；这能缩小搜索范围，但不能替代记录级去重。

污染与权利审计。 若上游出现基准或受限来源，枚举所有可达后代，并优先执行精确、近重复和语义检查；同时把许可与源文档证据作为边的审计元数据传播。论文演示了路径追踪，把权利传播加入图中属于下游扩展，不是作者已实现的功能。

可复现发布设计。 更完整的实现应发布版本化边台账，包含证据快照、复核决定、置信度校准、图 checksum 以及接受/拒绝边。每条构造记录还应保留源数据集 ID、源记录 ID、转换、去重结果和 split。这样才能把图级假设变为记录级发布台账。

受控实验。 在唯一指令数、verifier、optimizer 和计算量固定时，比较随机源采样、下游混合采样与叶节点引导采样，并在多样性指标之外评测答案正确性和下游训练。这样的实验才能检验本文的构造假设，而不是默认更大的 embedding dispersion 就代表更好的训练数据。

复用等级：在固定提交 681db3ab13eaa4391025d6c4b86ed5b58b73988e 后，代码与已发布 JSONL 图输出适合作为阅读、审计和重建起点。论文报告的 57 万条语料因未核验到不可变 corpus、许可、split、checksum 和记录级谱系，暂不支持训练复用；该项目也不应被视为带固定隐藏测试的评测 benchmark。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Keep the objects separate: the released JSONL describes dataset-level graph edges and metadata; the reported 570K Alpaca-style corpus is not present in the inspected official repository.
  • Read the scale chain exactly: 83 seeds expand to 430 nodes and 971 edges; 212 unique leaves are filtered to 31 sources; about 8.7M normalized rows are deduplicated to a reported 570K instructions.
  • Inspect Figure 2 and Appendix A first: sourcing/tracing use GPT-5.1, extraction uses Gemini-2.5-Flash, and aggregation uses Gemini-2.5-Pro; the current repository's gpt-5.4 default is later version drift.
  • Treat exact benchmark matches as auditable lower-bound evidence and leaf status as an observed-graph property, not proof of semantic independence or complete decontamination.
  • Read Table 4 only as an embedding-diversity comparison: Vendi Score 452.44 and Centroid Distance 0.6385 do not establish answer quality or downstream training gains.

• 始终区分两个对象：已发布 JSONL 描述数据集级图边与元数据；论文报告的 57 万条 Alpaca 风格语料不在核验到的官方仓库中。
  • 准确记住规模链：83 个种子扩展到 430 个节点和 971 条边；212 个唯一叶节点筛为 31 个来源；约 870 万条归一化记录去重为论文报告的 57 万条指令。
  • 优先阅读图 2 与附录 A：sourcing/tracing 使用 GPT-5.1，extraction 使用 Gemini-2.5-Flash，aggregation 使用 Gemini-2.5-Pro；当前仓库默认的 gpt-5.4 是后续版本漂移。
  • 把基准精确匹配视为可审计的下界证据，把叶节点身份视为观察图的属性，而不是语义独立或完整去污染的证明。
  • 表 4 只应读作 embedding 多样性比较：Vendi Score 452.44 与 Centroid Distance 0.6385 不能证明答案质量或下游训练增益。
